from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    nr, nc = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    # Trace diagonally until one coordinate is next to the target, then continue
    # along the other axis, stopping one cell short of the target.
    for _ in range(max(0, min(nr-1, nc-1))):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-abf1d557.py'
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
demo=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; demo[3][11]=2; demo[10][1]=1
out=m.transform(demo)
print([(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3])
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)];test[1][4]=1;test[13][12]=2
res=m.transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in res))
